items.title: 14.5.1 Fossil fuels jalane ka fiza par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.5.1 with Figure 14.2, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Fossil fuels ka jalna maujooda climate change ki bunyadi wajah hai, zameen ke ecosystems ko badalta aur insani aur maholiyati sehat ke masail paida karta hua. Yeh zameen ke nizam par kai tarah asar dalta hai, jin mein greenhouse gas ikhraj, hawa ki aaloodgi aur volatile organic compounds shamil hain (Figure 14.2).

blocks.alt: Dehati manzar. Halke surkh teer Power stations (combustion), Motor vehicles (combustion) aur Livestock se SO2, NO2 aur NH3 tak uthte hain, oopar 'Emitted Pollutants' likha hai. Surkh lakeerein in gases ko particles/aerosols SO4 2−, NO3−, NH4+ tak aur neeche khet aur talab par 'Dry Deposition' tak le jati hain. Neele teer aerosols se 'Dry Deposition' aur jangal wali pahari par barish wale badal 'Wet Deposition' tak jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.2: Air pollutants ke atmosphere par asraat (kitab ki Figure 14.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gases hawa mein badal kar zarron (aerosols) mein tabdeel hoti hain: SO2 se sulfate, NO2 se nitrate aur NH3 se ammonium. Yeh zarre ya gases do tareeqon se zameen par wapas aate hain: khushk (dry deposition), yani khud neeche baith jana, aur geeli (wet deposition), yani barish ke saath girna, jo acid rain ka sabab banti hai.

blocks.prompt: Fossil fuel ka jalna maujooda climate change ki bunyadi wajah kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Jala har tonne coal, oil ya gas woh carbon dioxide fiza mein shamil karta hai jo lakhon saal zameen ke andar band thi, saath methane aur nitrous oxide; yeh greenhouse gases nikalti garmi rokti hain, aur sanat-kari ke baad se un ka musalsal izafa zameen ki napi gai garmi se milta hai.

items: Fossil fuel ka jalna: climate change ki bunyadi wajah; greenhouse gases, hawa ki aaloodgi aur VOCs ecosystems aur sehat ko nuqsan dete hain.
